text: This report addresses an appeal concerning three variances sought for one first party illuminated electronic ground sign displaying static copy and electronic static copy (the "Proposed Sign"). Ruth Plowright of Libertevision Ontario Inc. (the "Applicant") applied for three variances for the Proposed Sign which would be located on the northerly property frontage at 139 Millwick Drive (the "Premises"). After conducting a review in accordance with the requirements of the Sign By-law, a decision was made to refuse to grant the necessary variances. Subsequently, Isaac De-Graft Takyi of the Living Word Assembly of God Church (the "Appellant") appealed the decision. It has been determined that the Applicant did not provide enough information to establish that the Proposed Sign meets all nine of the criteria contained at §694-30A of the Sign By-law. The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Refused to grant the three requested variances for the Proposed Sign at the Premises municipally known as 139 Millwick Drive, as described in Attachment 1 of the report (March 5, 2018) from the Manager, Sign By-law Unit, Toronto Building.
